name: 2D Projective Grid Traversal
definition: A raycasting optimization for DepthMesh that replaces brute-force triangle intersection checks with a traversal of a 2D projective grid. It exploits the property that vertices of a DepthMesh lie along perspective unprojection rays from the camera origin, causing 3D triangles in a grid cell to project strictly inside that 2D cell under central projection.
summary: 2D Projective Grid Traversal optimizes raycasting by projecting rays into a 2D grid to visit only relevant cells, reducing intersection checks from thousands to approximately 20–40.
